content:
Ariel: Heads-up  flying into Brussels for a client visit, staying by EU quarter. Need best spot for waffles + a good moules-frites place. Any veggie-friendly recs too?

Lucas: For waffles: 'Maison Dandoy' near Grand Place is classic (thin Brussels waffles). Bring cash for some stalls.

Sofie: Moules-frites: 'Chez Léon' is touristy but reliable. For a less touristy option try 'Noordzee Mer du Nord' for seafood plates to-go (they do good steamed mussels).

Tom: Veg-friendly: try 'Le Botaniste' for plant-based bowls and they do a nice frites. Also 'EXKi' has warm vegetarian soups that travel well.

Ariel: Amazing, can someone paste quick addresses?

Lucas: Quick list:
Maison Dandoy  Rue Charles Buls 14, 1000 Bruxelles
Chez Léon  Rue des Bouchers 18, 1000 Bruxelles
Noordzee Mer du Nord  Rue Sainte-Catherine 45, 1000 Bruxelles
Le Botaniste  Rue du Bailli 23, 1050 Bruxelles
EXKi (various)  EU quarter branches

Sofie: If you're around lunchtime the seafood stalls by Sainte-Catherine are perfect for quick eats. Also try speculoos spread on waffles 36a

Ariel: Want to do an easy crawl Sat noon?

lunchbot: Poll created "Brussels waffle + mussels crawl Sat noon?" Options: 1) Yes 2) No 3) Maybe. Vote with :one:/:two:/:three:.

Tom: :one: if we can hit Noordzee first.

Lucas: :three: I might be in Leiden that weekend but will try.

Ariel: Thanks team! I'll book time by the EU office if poll leans yes.
